Committee: Veterans and Military Affairs
Sponsor: Whatley
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 02/02/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 81 as introduced would add an additional six members to the nine-member Armory Commission and require the Armory Commission to meet at least twice a year. This would increase the administrative obligations of the Armory Commission by a minimum of $3,100 to reimburse the new members for expenses allowed under law and for the increased minimum meeting requirements for existing members.
Tom Butler, Chairperson
Veterans and Military Affairs
